MeshAddressSelector.description:
Explicit mesh target selector for safety-sensitive remote calls.

The selector is optional on bus payloads so transparent module routing
remains backward compatible. When present, routing treats peer/provider
fields as binding hints and validates them before falling back to module
selection.
MeshAddressSelector.title: MeshAddressSelector

schema.description:
Authenticated recipient projection request.

Recipient identity is deliberately absent: the RPC envelope is the only
authority.  The last committed values are refresh hints, never selectors.
schema.title: ToolingGetExportCatalogRequest

ToolingRateLimitHints.description: Optional rate-limit hints for a discovered tool provider.
ToolingRateLimitHints.title: ToolingRateLimitHints

ToolingToolInfo.description:
Typed metadata for a discovered tool.

``name`` remains the bindable tool name expected by existing
orchestrator code. For local-only discovery it is the provider-local
name; for provider-selected mesh discovery it is namespaced to avoid
collisions.
ToolingToolInfo.title: ToolingToolInfo

ToolingToolProvenance.description: Provenance carried with a discovered tool.
